description: The verifiers on Asks: each one checks answers by its own rules instead of rules written for the ask. For each: its name, what it checks, the checks it offers, what an answer must give (the questions, which are needed), its fee per check, and whether a person can give final approval. Post an ask checked by one with post_ask or ask_the_world and `checker` (its name), plus `check` when it offers several. Spends nothing.
name: list_checkers
title: List verifiers
